title: The Outsourcing of America’s Border Problem

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是 Benjamin Poulin，我是 Mark Ronson，欢迎收听《重构者》（The Reframers），这是一档关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店当 DJ 的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带上 300 件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，把 DJ 台变成一个充满 50 年历史精美文物的流动博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是 Sabrina Tavernisi，这是《每日新闻》（The Daily）。

sentences.en: At least 40 migrants are dead after a fire at a detention center in Mexico near the U.S.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥一处靠近美国边境的拘留中心发生火灾，造成至少 40 名移民死亡。

sentences.en: border.
sentences.zh: 边境。

sentences.en: One by one, Mexican soldiers pull people out of the building.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥士兵一个接一个地将人们从大楼里拉出来。

sentences.en: Mylar blankets covering the dead, 28 seriously hurt.
sentences.zh: 聚酯薄膜毯覆盖着死者，另有 28 人受重伤。

sentences.en: A fatal fire in an immigrant detention center in Juarez, Mexico.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥华雷斯市一家移民拘留中心发生致命火灾。

sentences.en: Before the fire, Mexican police arrested migrants off the streets and threw them into the cells.
sentences.zh: 火灾发生前，墨西哥警察在街上逮捕了移民，并将他们关进牢房。

sentences.en: Many of the shelters there were oversaturated and overwhelmed, overcrowded.
sentences.zh: 当地许多收容所已经超负荷、不堪重负，人满为患。

sentences.en: Raised troubling questions about the ways immigration is being handled by the United States.
sentences.zh: 这引发了关于美国处理移民问题方式的令人不安的质疑。

sentences.en: There is no question that we have a very serious challenge.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，我们面临着一个非常严峻的挑战。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Simone Romero, on how America outsourced its immigration dilemma to Mexico and brought cities like Juarez to a breaking point.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事 Simone Romero 将讲述美国如何将其移民困境“外包”给墨西哥，并使华雷斯这样的城市陷入崩溃边缘。

sentences.en: It's Friday, April 7th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 4 月 7 日，星期五。

sentences.en: So, Simone, you've been doing a lot of reporting at the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，Simone，你一直在美墨边境进行大量的报道。

sentences.en: border with Mexico.
sentences.zh: 边境。

sentences.en: And I know recently you've been focused on this terrible fire that broke out at a detention center just on the Mexican side.
sentences.zh: 我知道你最近一直关注着墨西哥一侧拘留中心发生的这场可怕火灾。

sentences.en: What have you found out in the time since it broke out?
sentences.zh: 火灾发生以来，你了解到了什么情况？

sentences.en: So, on Monday, March 27th, authorities in Ciudad Juarez in northern Mexico went around the city and they began rounding up dozens of migrants
sentences.zh: 3 月 27 日，星期一，墨西哥北部华雷斯市的当局在全市范围内开始搜捕数十名移民，

sentences.en: after receiving complaints that they had been begging or harassing people on the streets of the city.
sentences.zh: 此前他们接到投诉，称这些移民在街上乞讨或骚扰路人。

sentences.en: And they took them to this facility, which really resembles a jail more than a shelter.
sentences.zh: 他们把这些人带到了这个设施，与其说是收容所，不如说更像监狱。

sentences.en: And it lies just steps away from the border with the United States.
sentences.zh: 它距离美国边境仅几步之遥。

sentences.en: One of the men picked up that day was a Venezuelan and husband of a woman I met in Juarez, Viangli Infante Padron.
sentences.zh: 当天被抓走的人中有一名委内瑞拉人，他是我在华雷斯遇到的一位女士 Viangli Infante Padron 的丈夫。

sentences.en: She told me that she had been traveling literally for months with their three young children in a desperate attempt to get to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，为了能到达美国边境申请庇护，她带着三个年幼的孩子在绝望中跋涉了整整几个月。

sentences.en: border with the hope of applying for asylum.
sentences.zh: 边境。

sentences.en: And they had been staying in Juarez since December.
sentences.zh: 他们从去年 12 月起就一直待在华雷斯。

sentences.en: And the day that he was rounded up, she said that he had been out buying medication for their daughter, who has a medical condition that causes her to have seizures.
sentences.zh: 她说，他被抓走的那天，正出门为女儿买药，女儿患有某种疾病，会导致癫痫发作。

sentences.en: Almost immediately, when she heard that he had been detained, she got up with her kids and raced over to the facility with his migration papers.
sentences.zh: 几乎在他被拘留的消息传出后，她立刻带着孩子拿着他的移民证件冲向了那个设施。

sentences.en: She actually had to wait there with her children for hours pleading with officials, trying to get him out, trying to get him released.
sentences.zh: 她实际上带着孩子在那里等了几个小时，苦苦哀求官员，试图让他获释。

sentences.en: Around 9 p.m.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上 9 点左右，

sentences.en: that evening, she was told that he would be released that night.
sentences.zh: 她被告知他当晚就会获释。

sentences.en: But shortly after, her son noticed the smell of something burning.
sentences.zh: 但没过多久，她的儿子闻到了烧焦的味道。

sentences.en: Then they heard the screams coming from lower down of the facility and banging on the walls.
sentences.zh: 随后他们听到设施下方传来的尖叫声和撞击墙壁的声音。

sentences.en: But she said that migration officials were just sitting there, as if they couldn't smell or hear anything.
sentences.zh: 但她说，移民官员只是坐在那里，好像根本闻不到也听不到任何动静。

sentences.en: Eventually, she said, she sees them start to bring some women out.
sentences.zh: 最终，她说她看到他们开始带出一些女性。

sentences.en: But all of the men were still inside, including her husband.
sentences.zh: 但所有的男性仍被困在里面，包括她的丈夫。

sentences.en: And that's when she started to panic.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，她开始恐慌起来。

sentences.en: Yo me pongo a discutir con uno de ellos y le digo que por qué ellos van a cerrar la puerta y no le hablen la celda a los hombres.
sentences.zh: 我跟他们其中一个人争论，问他们为什么要关门，为什么不打开牢房让男人们出来。

sentences.en: Officials then told her to get out of the building, otherwise she could face some sort of legal consequences.
sentences.zh: 官员随后让她离开大楼，否则她可能会面临某种法律后果。

sentences.en: So she went to the outskirts of the facility.
sentences.zh: 于是她去了设施外围。

sentences.en: She was stranded on the sidewalk outside, witnessing the fire trucks arriving.
sentences.zh: 她被困在外面的人行道上，目睹了消防车的到来。

sentences.en: And she actually saw bodies being removed from the facility.
sentences.zh: 她甚至亲眼看到尸体被从设施里抬出来。

sentences.en: God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Charred remains.
sentences.zh: 烧焦的遗体。

sentences.en: She didn't know if those were the remains of her husband or not, or who they belonged to.
sentences.zh: 她不知道那是不是她丈夫的遗体，也不知道那是谁的。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Until she finally saw him.
sentences.zh: 直到她最终见到了他。

sentences.en: He was protected.
sentences.zh: 他受到了保护。

sentences.en: Me dijo que entró al baño y se mojó.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我他进了厕所，把自己弄湿了。

sentences.en: Ahí quedó él en el baño.
sentences.zh: 他就待在厕所里。

sentences.en: Este, que por eso no se quemó.
sentences.zh: 所以他才没有被烧伤。

sentences.en: Porque él entró al baño inmediatamente.
sentences.zh: 因为他立刻进了厕所。

sentences.en: And she told me that he managed to survive by going into a bathroom at the facility and covering himself in water in a desperate effort to prevent himself from being burned.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，他通过躲进设施里的厕所并用水淋湿全身，在绝望中避免了被烧伤，从而幸存了下来。

sentences.en: But he did emerge with serious smoke inhalation injuries and was immediately hospitalized.
sentences.zh: 但他出来时因严重吸入烟雾而受伤，并立即被送往医院。

sentences.en: So, Simone, that's just an unbelievably painful account of what happened during the fire.
sentences.zh: Simone，这真是一段令人心碎的火灾经过描述。

sentences.en: Do we have any more information about how it actually started?
sentences.zh: 我们有更多关于火灾起因的信息吗？

sentences.en: So, the first pieces of information that we have came from Mexican government officials.
sentences.zh: 我们得到的第一手信息来自墨西哥政府官员。

sentences.en: They said that some of the migrants being held in the facility started the blaze by lighting mattresses on fire as a form of proteSt.
sentences.zh: 他们说，被关押在设施内的一些移民通过点燃床垫进行抗议，从而引发了火灾。

sentences.en: Apparently, these migrants who were being held, they were upset, first of all, that they had been detained without having committed any crimes.
sentences.zh: 显然，这些被关押的移民感到愤怒，首先是因为他们在没有犯罪的情况下被拘留。

sentences.en: And were protesting the conditions inside.
sentences.zh: 并且在抗议内部的条件。

sentences.en: You know, they were contending that they hadn't been given any water.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们声称自己连水都没给喝。

sentences.en: They were being held behind bars in essentially what they viewed as a jail.
sentences.zh: 他们被关在铁栏杆后面，本质上他们认为这就是监狱。

sentences.en: But pretty quickly, surveillance videos surfaced presenting a darker side to what had happened.
sentences.zh: 但很快，监控录像浮出水面，展现了事件更黑暗的一面。

sentences.en: There's video from inside the facility that shows uniformed people saw the smoke filling the cells and then left without opening the cells or the doors,
sentences.zh: 设施内部的视频显示，身穿制服的人员看到烟雾弥漫牢房，却在没有打开牢房或大门的情况下离开了，

sentences.en: effectively leaving men trapped inside.
sentences.zh: 实际上是将男人们困在了里面。

sentences.en: Oh, man.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And now there's a homicide investigation into the fire and at least five people have been arrested.
sentences.zh: 目前针对这场火灾的谋杀调查已经展开，至少有五人被捕。

sentences.en: Three government employees, a security guard for a private contractor, and one of the detainees accused of actually starting the blaze.
sentences.zh: 包括三名政府雇员、一名私人承包商的保安，以及一名被指控纵火的被拘留者。

sentences.en: And really, while this fire is obviously tragic,
sentences.zh: 说实话，虽然这场火灾显然是一场悲剧，

sentences.en: it's also the latest in a long chain of events and pressure that's been building in policy change after policy change that has been keeping people amassed in cities like Juarez along the border.
sentences.zh: 但它也是一系列政策变动所带来的长期压力和连锁反应的最新体现，这些政策导致人们在华雷斯等边境城市不断聚集。

sentences.en: Okay, so tell me about that, Simone.
sentences.zh: 好的，Simone，跟我说说这个情况。

sentences.en: Where does that story begin?
sentences.zh: 这个故事是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: Well, there have been decades of failed immigration policies that certainly play a role.
sentences.zh: 嗯，几十年来失败的移民政策无疑在其中扮演了角色。

sentences.en: But as far as where to start this current chapter of the story, all of that has been exacerbated since the depths of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 但如果要从这一章节的起点说起，这一切在疫情最严重时期加剧了。

sentences.en: And that's due to the embrace of an arcane rule known as Title 42 that was used by the Trump administration to quickly expel migrants who were showing up at the border and even some seeking asylum.
sentences.zh: 这是因为采用了被称为“第 42 条”（Title 42）的晦涩规则，特朗普政府曾利用该规则迅速驱逐出现在边境的移民，甚至包括一些寻求庇护者。

sentences.en: This was presumably to prevent them from transmitting COVID due to fears over infections at that point.
sentences.zh: 这据称是为了防止他们在当时因担心感染而传播新冠病毒。

sentences.en: When the Biden administration came in, they tried to discard this rule, but they weren't able to do so.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府上台后，试图废除这一规则，但未能成功。

sentences.en: There was a huge legal battle that went all the way up to the Supreme Court, and the rule was kept in place.
sentences.zh: 经过一场一直打到最高法院的激烈法律战，该规则被保留了下来。

sentences.en: And so this meant that large numbers of migrants coming from many countries simply could not get into the United States during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这意味着在疫情期间，来自许多国家的大量移民根本无法进入美国。

sentences.en: But there was one critical exception, and that was for people coming from countries like Venezuela, with which the United States has very bad or very tense diplomatic relations.
sentences.zh: 但有一个关键的例外，那就是来自委内瑞拉等与美国外交关系非常糟糕或非常紧张的国家的移民。

sentences.en: It meant that U.S.
sentences.zh: 这意味着美国

sentences.en: officials simply cannot send those people back to those countries.
sentences.zh: 官员根本无法将这些人送回这些国家。

sentences.en: They cannot deport Venezuelans back to Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 他们无法将委内瑞拉人驱逐回委内瑞拉。

sentences.en: So then those people were getting into the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以这些人得以进入美国。

sentences.en: Many of them were being able to enter the United States, yes, as part of the process that involves them applying for asylum.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人确实能够进入美国，作为申请庇护程序的一部分。

sentences.en: And, you know, this was adding political pressure at the time.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这在当时增加了政治压力。

sentences.en: This was ahead of the midterms, we have to remember.
sentences.zh: 我们必须记住，那是在中期选举之前。

sentences.en: And we had a lot of Democratic candidates running in border states like Arizona, like Texas, who were coming under criticism because of this influx.
sentences.zh: 当时亚利桑那州、德克萨斯州等边境州的许多民主党候选人因为这种涌入而受到批评。

sentences.en: So in October, the Biden administration made a change that really just upended everything.
sentences.zh: 因此在 10 月份，拜登政府做出了一个彻底改变局势的调整。

sentences.en: They struck a deal with Mexico that, among other things, allowed them to send Venezuelans back to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他们与墨西哥达成了一项协议，除其他事项外，允许他们将委内瑞拉人送回墨西哥。

sentences.en: So effectively closed the exception for Venezuelans.
sentences.zh: 实际上取消了针对委内瑞拉人的例外情况。

sentences.en: That's exactly what they did.
sentences.zh: 他们正是这么做的。

sentences.en: And this led to plummeting numbers of arrivals of Venezuelans on the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这导致美国境内的委内瑞拉人入境人数急剧下降。

sentences.en: side.
sentences.zh: 边境。

sentences.en: And so this policy really worked so well that the Biden administration then applied it to other countries such as Cuba, such as Nicaragua, with which the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这项政策非常有效，以至于拜登政府随后将其应用到古巴、尼加拉瓜等与美国外交关系同样紧张的国家。

sentences.en: also has strained diplomatic relations.
sentences.zh: 同样有紧张的外交关系。

sentences.en: But while the numbers were plummeting on the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但当美国境内的数字急剧下降时，

sentences.en: side, Mexico had to continue dealing with this influx.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥却不得不继续应对这种涌入。

sentences.en: Why did Mexico agree to it?
sentences.zh: 为什么墨西哥会同意呢？

sentences.en: Well, we have to remember that Mexico really had already come under immense pressure during the Trump administration to do something,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们必须记住，墨西哥在特朗普政府时期就已经承受了巨大的压力，要求其采取行动，

sentences.en: to do anything about the situation along the border.
sentences.zh: 对边境局势采取任何措施。

sentences.en: The United States exerts immense influence in Mexico's economy.
sentences.zh: 美国对墨西哥经济有着巨大的影响力。

sentences.en: It remains Mexico's largest trading partner.
sentences.zh: 美国仍然是墨西哥最大的贸易伙伴。

sentences.en: Also, it's kind of, in a way, politically expedient for Mexico's president because with a deal like this,
sentences.zh: 此外，从某种程度上说，这对墨西哥总统来说在政治上是权宜之计，因为有了这样的协议，

sentences.en: Mexico's president can really pursue his domestic policies without much explicit criticism from Washington.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥总统可以在不受到华盛顿明确批评的情况下推行其国内政策。

sentences.en: That's a big deal for him.
sentences.zh: 这对他是件大事。

sentences.en: And that's really effectively been the case.
sentences.zh: 事实也确实如此。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: has largely been hands-off in terms of criticizing him, especially when it comes to weakening an election law.
sentences.zh: 在批评他方面基本保持不干涉态度，尤其是在削弱选举法的问题上。

sentences.en: So the deal to close this exception to Title 42 went into effect in October.
sentences.zh: 因此，取消“第 42 条”这一例外情况的协议于 10 月生效。

sentences.en: And from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 从美国的

sentences.en: perspective, it worked.
sentences.zh: 角度来看，它奏效了。

sentences.en: But the problem didn't go away.
sentences.zh: 但问题并没有消失。

sentences.en: It just shifted to the other side of the border.
sentences.zh: 它只是转移到了边境的另一侧。

sentences.en: And so, effectively, what we're seeing on the ground is an outsourcing of the immigration dilemma from the United States to Mexico,
sentences.zh: 实际上，我们在实地看到的是美国将移民困境“外包”给了墨西哥，

sentences.en: where migrants are still arriving in huge numbers, where they're amassing.
sentences.zh: 移民们仍然大量涌入，并在那里聚集。

sentences.en: And you see this especially on the streets of Juarez.
sentences.zh: 你在华雷斯的街头尤其能看到这一点。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33 位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning, and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨 4 点 30 分给总统打了电话，他接听了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today, I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天，我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60 款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟中最棒的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: Celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 庆祝 175 年来帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅即可在 nytimes.com/subscribe 享受特别优惠。

sentences.en: So, Simone, what does this increase in migrants along the border look like in Juarez?
sentences.zh: 那么，Simone，边境移民的增加在华雷斯是什么样的情况？

sentences.en: Like, how has this border city been affected?
sentences.zh: 这座边境城市受到了怎样的影响？

sentences.en: Well, we really have to remember what Juarez is.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们真的必须记住华雷斯是什么样的地方。

sentences.en: It's a city that really views itself as a place of migration, as a place of refuge, as a place of passage.
sentences.zh: 它是一座真正将自己视为移民之地、避难之所、过境之地的城市。

sentences.en: The original name for the entire area was El Paso del Norte, the Pass of the North, reflecting how people have been transiting through this area for hundreds of years.
sentences.zh: 整个地区最初的名字是“北方通道”（El Paso del Norte），反映了数百年来人们一直通过该地区过境的历史。

sentences.en: What's different now, though, is that instead of passing through, they're stuck.
sentences.zh: 但现在的不同之处在于，他们没有通过，而是被困住了。

sentences.en: They're staying put for weeks or months at a time.
sentences.zh: 他们一次停留数周甚至数月。

sentences.en: And why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why are they stuck?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么被困住？

sentences.en: So, there are two big reasons.
sentences.zh: 有两个主要原因。

sentences.en: One is a new app that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 一个是美国推出的一款新应用程序，

sentences.en: introduced, which these restricted nationalities under Title
sentences.zh: 这些受“第 42 条”限制国籍的移民现在必须使用该程序来预约申请庇护。

sentences.en: 42 must now use to secure an appointment where they can request asylum.
sentences.zh: 42现在必须通过该系统预约，才能申请避难。

sentences.en: In the past, you could turn yourself in at the border, ask for asylum, and either be allowed in temporarily or be deported.
sentences.zh: 过去，你可以在边境自首，申请庇护，然后要么被允许临时进入，要么被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: The app essentially makes that step virtual.
sentences.zh: 该应用程序本质上是将这一步骤虚拟化了。

sentences.en: And you have to apply for that asylum appointment using the app from Mexico.
sentences.zh: 你必须使用墨西哥的应用程序来申请庇护预约。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So, essentially, the sorting process for who's likely to get asylum happens in Mexico instead of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，本质上，谁更有可能获得庇护的筛选过程是在墨西哥进行的，而不是在美国。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this app has just been plagued with issues and different kinds of glitches.
sentences.zh: 而且这个应用程序一直饱受各种问题和故障的困扰。

sentences.en: And that's resulted in an even larger logjam of people hanging around on the border.
sentences.zh: 这导致在边境滞留的人员积压情况变得更加严重。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, what's the other reason people are hanging around longer?
sentences.zh: 那么，人们滞留时间更长的另一个原因是什么？

sentences.en: That has to do with the expectation that Title 42 is going to expire in May.
sentences.zh: 这与人们预期第42条法案将在五月份到期有关。

sentences.en: So, in anticipation of that, lots of people have gathered in border towns with the idea that in a month or so, it'll be much easier to cross the border.
sentences.zh: 因此，出于这种预期，许多人聚集在边境城镇，认为再过一个月左右，越境就会容易得多。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, you have all of these new migrants from places like Venezuela and Nicaragua who would have gotten in before, but who are now being turned away.
sentences.zh: 所以，你现在有所有这些来自委内瑞拉和尼加拉瓜等地的新移民，他们以前本可以进入美国，但现在却被拒之门外。

sentences.en: Then you have this glitchy app.
sentences.zh: 然后你又有了这个故障频出的应用程序。

sentences.en: And on top of all of that, there's this anticipation that soon it will be easier to enter the United
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，人们还预期很快就能更容易地进入美国。

sentences.en: States.
sentences.zh: 美国。

sentences.en: And all of this together has created this kind of perfect storm for the situation on the
sentences.zh: 所有这些因素加在一起，在墨西哥一侧的边境造成了一种完美的风暴。

sentences.en: Mexican side of the border.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥一侧的边境。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And that's just a huge challenge for Juarez.
sentences.zh: 这对华雷斯来说是一个巨大的挑战。

sentences.en: You know, what you're seeing now is that many of the people who would have crossed through are actually staying.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你现在看到的是，许多本可以过境的人实际上留了下来。

sentences.en: And immediately after crossing the bridge from downtown El Paso, you see entire families at intersections there.
sentences.zh: 而且在穿过埃尔帕索市中心的桥梁后，你立刻就能看到路口处有整家整口的人。

sentences.en: They're often with infants.
sentences.zh: 他们通常带着婴儿。

sentences.en: They're often begging for money.
sentences.zh: 他们经常乞讨钱财。

sentences.en: You see migrants selling anything they can from sunglasses to flowers.
sentences.zh: 你会看到移民们在兜售他们能找到的任何东西，从太阳镜到鲜花。

sentences.en: They're cleaning the windshields of cars that are stuck in traffic.
sentences.zh: 他们在清理堵在交通中的汽车挡风玻璃。

sentences.en: You're seeing shelters way beyond their capacity.
sentences.zh: 你看到的避难所早已人满为患。

sentences.en: Families sleeping in abandoned construction sites, literally sleeping on the streets.
sentences.zh: 家庭睡在废弃的建筑工地上，甚至直接睡在街头。

sentences.en: And the numbers are just growing.
sentences.zh: 而且人数还在不断增加。

sentences.en: They continue to amass in Juarez.
sentences.zh: 他们继续在华雷斯聚集。

sentences.en: And it's really just increasing pressure on the city in ways that are kind of unprecedented,
sentences.zh: 这确实以一种前所未有的方式增加了城市的压力，

sentences.en: even for a place that views itself as welcoming, that views itself as a place that's used to such migration.
sentences.zh: 即使对于一个自认为是热情好客、习惯了这种移民潮的地方来说也是如此。

sentences.en: And what are people in Juarez saying?
sentences.zh: 那么华雷斯的人们是怎么说的呢？

sentences.en: How do they see this?
sentences.zh: 他们是如何看待这件事的？

sentences.en: Well, really, as the situation grows more dire and as, you know, the pressure increases, you can see that patience is really wearing thin among many people in Juarez.
sentences.zh: 嗯，随着局势变得越来越严峻，压力越来越大，你可以看出华雷斯的许多人已经失去了耐心。

sentences.en: And of course, amongst the migrants themselves who have carried out protests about the time that they have to spend waiting on the Mexican side.
sentences.zh: 当然，移民们自己也对在墨西哥一侧等待的时间进行了抗议。

sentences.en: At one point in March, migrants tried to rush across one of the bridges connecting El Paso and Juarez.
sentences.zh: 三月份的时候，移民们曾试图冲过连接埃尔帕索和华雷斯的一座桥梁。

sentences.en: And that just stunned many people.
sentences.zh: 那让很多人感到震惊。

sentences.en: It shut down traffic on that bridge.
sentences.zh: 它导致那座桥上的交通中断了。

sentences.en: And people in Juarez, you know, they depend on those bridges to study on the other side, to work on the other side, to see family on the other side.
sentences.zh: 而华雷斯的人们，你知道，他们依赖那些桥梁去另一边学习、工作、探望家人。

sentences.en: The economy of the city relies on those connections.
sentences.zh: 这座城市的经济依赖于这些联系。

sentences.en: And, you know, that elicited really what was a rare positioning by the city's mayor.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这引发了该市市长罕见的立场表态。

sentences.en: After that incident on the bridge, he came out and said, we're running out of patience.
sentences.zh: 在那次桥梁事件后，他公开表示，我们的耐心正在耗尽。

sentences.en: The city's economy cannot and should not be affected by the arrival of these migrants.
sentences.zh: 城市的经济不能也不应该受到这些移民到来的影响。

sentences.en: He also cited the presence of migrants at intersections and how that's affecting daily life in the city.
sentences.zh: 他还提到了移民在路口的出现，以及这如何影响了城市的日常生活。

sentences.en: And that's really quite something.
sentences.zh: 这确实非同寻常。

sentences.en: That was a change that's kind of like really shook people.
sentences.zh: 那是一个让人们感到震惊的转变。

sentences.en: They're not used to hearing pronouncements like that from their elected officials, from a city that really views itself as a place of refuge.
sentences.zh: 他们不习惯从民选官员那里听到这样的声明，尤其是在一个自认为是避难所的城市。

sentences.en: So this is the mayor saying out loud that the city's infrastructure is really being strained here, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这是市长在大声疾呼，城市的基建确实不堪重负了，对吧？

sentences.en: Like that they just simply cannot support the sheer numbers.
sentences.zh: 就像他们根本无法支撑如此庞大的人数一样。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So you have the mayor saying that.
sentences.zh: 所以市长这么说了。

sentences.en: And at the same time, you also have law enforcement taking a tougher approach, becoming more aggressive in their treatment of the migrants.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，执法部门也采取了更强硬的态度，在对待移民时变得更加激进。

sentences.en: You know, whether they're rounding up people, placing them in these detention centers.
sentences.zh: 你知道，无论是围捕人员，还是把他们关进这些拘留中心。

sentences.en: We've heard from migrants who have said that they've had to pay bribes to either migration officials or local police.
sentences.zh: 我们从移民那里听说，他们不得不向移民官员或当地警察行贿。

sentences.en: Even that they've had their identification documents burned by some of these officials,
sentences.zh: 甚至有人的身份证件被这些官员烧毁，

sentences.en: which would make eventually getting to the United States or applying for asylum even more difficult for them.
sentences.zh: 这使得他们最终前往美国或申请庇护变得更加困难。

sentences.en: And that creates a climate of fear and tension on the streets.
sentences.zh: 这在街头营造了一种恐惧和紧张的氛围。

sentences.en: At the same time, you're hearing these expressions of concern coming from elected officials.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，你听到民选官员表达了担忧。

sentences.en: You're also hearing from religious figures, from volunteer organizations, from shelter operators.
sentences.zh: 你也会听到宗教人士、志愿者组织和避难所经营者的声音。

sentences.en: These organizations have been fierce in their criticism of what the mayor said.
sentences.zh: 这些组织对市长的言论进行了猛烈的抨击。

sentences.en: They're saying that's not what we're about.
sentences.zh: 他们说，那不是我们的宗旨。

sentences.en: We have to stick to who we are.
sentences.zh: 我们必须坚持我们的本色。

sentences.en: And they believe that Juarez should remain a welcoming place that treats migrants with dignity.
sentences.zh: 他们认为华雷斯应该保持一个热情好客的地方，以尊严对待移民。

sentences.en: It's very complex, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，这非常复杂。

sentences.en: You know, I met one man who was born and raised in Juarez.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我遇到过一个在华雷斯出生长大的人。

sentences.en: His name is Carlos Amendariz, and he makes a living selling used tools in downtown Juarez, on the street.
sentences.zh: 他叫卡洛斯·阿门达里斯，他在华雷斯市中心的街头靠卖二手工具为生。

sentences.en: Anything he can pick up, screwdrivers, hammers, saws.
sentences.zh: 任何他能捡到的东西，螺丝刀、锤子、锯子。

sentences.en: And, you know, he himself was a migrant.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他自己也曾是一名移民。

sentences.en: He had worked in the United States for years in construction and was even deported back to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他曾在建筑行业为美国工作多年，甚至被驱逐回墨西哥。

sentences.en: And yet, he's concerned.
sentences.zh: 然而，他很担心。

sentences.en: He sees a lot of these migrants begging at intersections.
sentences.zh: 他看到很多移民在路口乞讨。

sentences.en: And he said that that's a real contrast with his own experience of trying to work hard and make a living.
sentences.zh: 他说这与他自己努力工作谋生的经历形成了鲜明的对比。

sentences.en: And, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，

sentences.en: he just really questioned whether they have the same gumption that people of his experience have had when they've had to really follow their own star across the border and sort of work and opportunity.
sentences.zh: 他真的很怀疑他们是否拥有像他这样的人在跨越边境追求梦想、工作和机会时所具备的那种毅力。

sentences.en: And is there any truth to what he's saying here?
sentences.zh: 他说的这些有道理吗？

sentences.en: Like that these migrants could work but don't want to?
sentences.zh: 比如这些移民本可以工作但却不想工作？

sentences.en: Many of them do actually work.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人实际上确实在工作。

sentences.en: I saw migrants, you know, selling staples of Venezuelan food, like arepas on the streets.
sentences.zh: 我看到移民们在街上兜售委内瑞拉的主食，比如玉米饼。

sentences.en: Really anything they could.
sentences.zh: 真的是他们能做的任何事。

sentences.en: At the same time, a lot of them can't work legally in jobs in factories in Juarez, you know, that are open to migrants from parts of Mexico.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他们中的许多人无法在华雷斯的工厂里合法工作，而那些工作对来自墨西哥其他地区的移民是开放的。

sentences.en: They don't have the right papers.
sentences.zh: 他们没有合法的证件。

sentences.en: They don't have a bank account.
sentences.zh: 他们没有银行账户。

sentences.en: They just don't have the infrastructure that's really necessary for jobs like that.
sentences.zh: 他们根本没有从事这类工作所必需的基础条件。

sentences.en: But also, the main reason many of them might not seek long-term employment is because their goal is still getting into the United States, not to stay in Juarez.
sentences.zh: 但同样，他们中的许多人可能不寻求长期就业的主要原因是，他们的目标仍然是进入美国，而不是留在华雷斯。

sentences.en: So many of them are just waking up every single day trying to desperately get their asylum appointment.
sentences.zh: 所以他们中的许多人每天醒来都在拼命尝试预约庇护。

sentences.en: And that means logging on to this app.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要登录这个应用程序。

sentences.en: You know, some of them have one, two, three different cell phones that they're using.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们中有些人有两三部不同的手机在使用。

sentences.en: And really, I spoke to dozens and dozens of people when I was in Juarez.
sentences.zh: 真的，我在华雷斯时和几十个人谈过。

sentences.en: None of them got that appointment except for one person, and that was Viangli, the woman whose husband survived the fire.
sentences.zh: 除了一个人之外，他们都没有预约成功，那个人就是维昂莉，她丈夫在那场火灾中幸存了下来。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's just incredible.
sentences.zh: 是的，真是不可思议。

sentences.en: And by the way, I mean, both she and her husband work every single day.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，她和她丈夫每天都在工作。

sentences.en: She works in an ice cream parlor.
sentences.zh: 她在冰淇淋店工作。

sentences.en: Her husband sells roses on the street.
sentences.zh: 她丈夫在街上卖玫瑰花。

sentences.en: So she managed to get an appointment.
sentences.zh: 所以她成功预约到了。

sentences.en: That is extremely rare, but it still does offer a semblance of hope to many of the other people who are trying to do the same thing.
sentences.zh: 这极其罕见，但它仍然给许多试图做同样事情的人带来了一丝希望。

sentences.en: So, Simone, is there any relief on the horizon?
sentences.zh: 那么，西蒙，未来会有缓解的迹象吗？

sentences.en: Like, it just feels like something in this situation has to give.
sentences.zh: 感觉这种情况必须有所改变。

sentences.en: You know, a lot of migrants and advocates thought you might see some relief in May when Title 42 is set to lift.
sentences.zh: 你知道，许多移民和倡导者认为，当第42条法案在五月份取消时，情况可能会有所缓解。

sentences.en: But for many people in the United States who are looking to limit immigration, the system is working.
sentences.zh: 但对于美国许多希望限制移民的人来说，这个系统正在发挥作用。

sentences.en: Numbers of arrivals have plummeted.
sentences.zh: 入境人数已经大幅下降。

sentences.en: They don't really have a lot of incentive to change things.
sentences.zh: 他们确实没有什么动力去改变现状。

sentences.en: And so people are really waiting to see what's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 所以人们真的在等待看看会发生什么。

sentences.en: The latest expectation is that the Biden administration is going to revert to another measure for people deemed to have entered the U.S.
sentences.zh: 最新的预期是，拜登政府将对被认为非法进入美国的人采取另一项措施，

sentences.en: unlawfully, along with a proposal which would help determine when and how asylum seekers can be expelled.
sentences.zh: 同时提出一项建议，以帮助确定何时以及如何驱逐寻求庇护者。

sentences.en: Some people even jokingly refer to this new rule that's coming as Title 43.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至开玩笑地把这项即将出台的新规定称为第43条法案。

sentences.en: So, in other words, it's going to be more of the same.
sentences.zh: 所以，换句话说，这只会是旧戏重演。

sentences.en: That's what a lot of people are saying along the border.
sentences.zh: 这就是边境沿线许多人的看法。

sentences.en: Mexico's economy continues to be extremely interconnected with that of the United States.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥的经济继续与美国的经济紧密相连。

sentences.en: And the conditions that people are fleeing from in countries other than Mexico continue to be extremely challenging economically and politically.
sentences.zh: 而人们逃离的那些非墨西哥国家的情况，在经济和政治上仍然极具挑战性。

sentences.en: It's just unlikely that any of these factors leading to this situation are going to change anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 导致这种情况的任何因素在短期内都不太可能改变。

sentences.en: So, it's likely you're only going to see this pressure continuing to build in border cities like Juarez.
sentences.zh: 因此，像华雷斯这样的边境城市，这种压力很可能会持续增加。

sentences.en: And what many people fear is that tragedies like this fire are probably not the last that we're going to see.
sentences.zh: 许多人担心，像这次火灾这样的悲剧可能不会是我们看到的最后一次。

sentences.en: Simone, thank you.
sentences.zh: 西蒙，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Serena.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，塞雷娜。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏吧。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the Biden administration waded into the debate over transgender athletes, announcing a proposed rule change that would prohibit schools from categorically banning
sentences.zh: 周四，拜登政府介入了关于跨性别运动员的辩论，宣布了一项拟议的规则变更，将禁止学校全面禁止

sentences.en: transgender students from athletic teams that are consistent with their gender identities.
sentences.zh: 跨性别学生参加与其性别认同一致的运动队。

sentences.en: But the proposed change to Title IX, the federal civil rights law that prevents discrimination
sentences.zh: 但这项针对《教育法第九条》的拟议变更——该联邦民权法旨在防止教育项目中的性别歧视——

sentences.en: based on sex in education programs, would also offer flexibility to limit the participation of transgender students when including them could undermine, quote,
sentences.zh: 也将提供灵活性，在包含跨性别学生可能破坏所谓的“比赛公平性”或可能导致受伤的情况下，限制他们的参与。

sentences.en: fairness in competition or potentially lead to injuries.
sentences.zh: 比赛公平性或可能导致受伤。

sentences.en: And in the wake of a school shooting in Nashville last week, three Democratic lawmakers took to
sentences.zh: 在上周纳什维尔发生校园枪击案后，三名民主党议员走上

sentences.en: the floor of the Republican-controlled Tennessee House chamber and interrupted debate by leading protesters in a call for stricter gun laws.
sentences.zh: 共和党控制的田纳西州众议院议事厅，通过带领抗议者呼吁制定更严格的枪支法来打断了辩论。

sentences.en: On Thursday, in a dramatic act of political retribution, the state's legislature voted to oust two of them.
sentences.zh: 周四，在一场戏剧性的政治报复行动中，州议会投票驱逐了其中两名议员。

sentences.en: The ousted lawmakers, Justin Jones and Justin Pearson, two of the state's youngest Black representatives, can run again for their seats.
sentences.zh: 被驱逐的议员贾斯汀·琼斯和贾斯汀·皮尔逊，是该州最年轻的两名黑人代表，他们可以再次竞选自己的席位。

sentences.en: But the ousters temporarily leave thousands of residents in Memphis and in Nashville without representation in the final weeks of Tennessee's legislative session.
sentences.zh: 但这次驱逐暂时导致孟菲斯和纳什维尔成千上万的居民在田纳西州立法会议的最后几周里失去了代表权。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。
